design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label; pick order = xoshiro128**(picks seed), partial Fisher-Yates over 0..39

pass1.streams: one per pick count, each on its own seed labels
pass1.hits: hits[n − 1][k] = rounds of the n-pick stream that hit k; balls, firstBall, lag1 and runs count every round of every stream

pass2.earlyWindow: the epoch's captured nonce range, 1..its bet count
pass2.statistic: standardized return: Σ (micro − mean)/sd over the slots, ÷ √slots, exact mean and sd per configuration
